concerns.text: FR-003 and US-2 require implementation of CUSUM and VAE baselines. Tasks T021 (CUSUM), T022 (VAE), and T023 (Integration) are marked [ ] (incomplete). Without these, the Baseline Comparison Engine (US-2) is non-functional, violating the spec's mandatory requirement for baseline comparators.

FR-007 (Sensitivity Analysis), FR-012 (Fixed Thresholding), and SC-004/SC-005 (Correlation/Threshold sweep) require specific analysis and visualization. Tasks T027 (Sensitivity Analysis), T028 (Fig1), T029 (Fig2), and T030 (Results.md) are marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec's statistical significance and detectability analysis (US-3) cannot be completed.

Phase 7 lists critical remediation tasks (T048-T064) as [ ] (incomplete). These include extending the anomaly injector (T048), auditing paths (T050), fixing spec formatting (T052), and implementing missing scripts (T053-T057). The spec requires these artifacts (e.,g., results.md, figures) to be generated; their absence prevents the pipeline from satisfying FR-008 (associational findings) and Constitution Principle IV (Single Source of Truth).

Task T047 suggests refactoring to 'Dirichlet Process Mixture' or admitting a 'parametric GP' limitation. This tag references a non-existent requirement in the current spec/plan which mandates 'Sparse Variational Inference' (FR-002, Plan Complexity). The task description contradicts the spec's mandatory nonparametric claim, creating a stale/incorrect tag that needs correction to align with FR-002.

Task T051 instructs to 'Standardize plan.md and spec.md dates'. The spec and plan provided in the input have dates '2026-06-26'. This task references a requirement to fix dates that does not exist in the current spec/plan text (no date mismatch is visible). This is a stale tag from a previous review cycle that no applies to the current artifact state.
